dhp2:1: Mind precedes thoughts, mind is their chief,
dhp2:6: like a shadow which does not depart.

dhp9:4: is not worthy of the renunciant’s robe.

dhp11:1: Finding the essential in what is unessential,

dhp11:3: they do not understand what is essential,
dhp12:1: Knowing the essential in what is essential,
dhp12:2: and the unessential in what is unessential,
dhp13:1: Just as the rain penetrates a house with thatching that is poor,
dhp13:3: so passion penetrates a mind that is undeveloped.
dhp14:1: Just as rain does not penetrate a house with thatching that is good,
dhp14:3: so passion cannot penetrate a mind that is well-developed.
dhp15:1: Here he laments, after death he laments,
dhp15:2: the wicked one laments in both places,
dhp15:4: seeing the defilement of his own deeds.
dhp16:1: Here he rejoices, after death he rejoices,
dhp16:2: the meritorious one rejoices in both places,
dhp16:4: seeing the purity of his own deeds.
dhp17:1: Here he suffers, after death he suffers,
dhp17:2: the wicked one suffers in both places,
dhp17:3: he suffers, thinking: “I have done wickedness,”
dhp17:4: gone to a bad fate, he suffers much more.
dhp18:1: Here she is happy, after death she is happy,
dhp18:2: the righteous one is happy in both places,
dhp18:3: she is happy, thinking: “I have done merit,”
dhp18:4: gone to a good fate, she is happy much more.
